data.indexCnDesc: 上证红利指数选取在上海证券交易所上市的现金股息率高、分红比较稳定、具有一定规模及流动性的50只证券作为指数样本，以反映沪市高股息率证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: SSE Dividend Index selects 50 high and steady-cash dividend-paying companies listed in Shanghai Stock Exchange as the constituents. The index is to measure the performance of the high dividend-paying companies of Shanghai Stock Exchange.
